column1: # coverage-rehome-allowlist.tsv -- documented legitimate assertion RELOCATIONS for the
# A reduced/removed (old-suite, old-key) is EXCUSED as a re-home iff a rule below
# maps it to a (new-suite, new-key) that is PRESENT in the after-inventory. A rule
# whose target is absent is reported as 'claimed but not landed' and FAILS the gate.
# Schema (TAB-separated, 5 fields); '#'-comment and blank lines are ignored:
# This forward-going allowlist starts EMPTY. The work-024 SGH00a -> SEC00 re-home was
# relative to the pre-work-024 merge-base and is already absorbed into master, so it is
# NOT seeded here. Append one reviewed row per future re-home, then re-run the gate to
# confirm the target landed in the after-inventory.
# grade-summary.sh was renamed emit-summary-findings.sh and stopped computing a grade, so three
# assertion LABELS changed while the assertions themselves survived and got stricter. Re-homes, not
# removals: each target below is present in the after-inventory.

column5: AC3f asserted two things under one label (COV=full 15/15, and Machine Grade != F). The score and the Machine Grade both ceased to exist, so the pair was re-expressed as AC3f (a full-coverage summary emits NO SUMMARY-01 row) plus AC3f-2 (the emitter reports no grade of any kind, NFR-7). Same two claims, neither weakened.

column2: GR-C6a: grade-summary.sh COV works correctly when settings.yml also has kb_baseline block
column4: GR-C6a: doc_set parsing is unaffected by a sibling kb_baseline block in settings.yml
column5: Same guardrail (a kb_baseline block must not break doc_set parsing), same fixture. The observable proof changed because the old one read "COV [PASS]" out of a grade report that no longer exists; it now asserts the coverage check RAN and found nothing, and fails on either "not evaluated" or a spurious row.
